info.prompt: The game unfolds inside a cybernetic reliquary, where bone-white gold frames pulse with neon cyan energy, casting long shadows over a void black abyss. Translucent ice-stone tiles shimmer with internal fire, their surfaces etched with synaptic geometry that flares to life with each perfect beat—suddenly, the Flow meter maxes out, triggering a frenzy of oscillating waveforms and hacker text that scrolls like a digital psalm.
